name: Royal Hotel Thurso
accommodation: 103 en-suite rooms: single, double, twin, triple and family
suitableFor: Groups, families and travellers wanting plenty of room choice
beachAccess: Described as close to the beach
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, bar, free Wi-Fi, luggage storage, laundry service
overview: The Royal Hotel sits on Traill Street in Thurso town centre, around a seven-minute walk from the railway station and described as close to the beach. Its 103 en-suite rooms range from singles to family rooms. There is a restaurant, bar and free parking.
surfTripFit: Free parking and lots of rooms make it a practical base for a group surf trip to the Thurso reefs.
